issues.problem: The stress-cause model answers on invalid and low-quality inputs, and can output "Diseased". The cause task has no Healthy class, so its confidence threshold falls to the 0.30 floor and it never abstains on confidence; the out-of-range test passes inf / -999 / 1e12 because only 4 of 77 features are outside the range (5% < 20%).
issues.evidence: phase_safety.json: stress_cause case 5 (inf, -inf, -999, 1e12) -> "Stressed" at 0.879; case 2 (typical stressed field) -> "Diseased" at 0.717; case 7 (lowest-confidence validation row, p=0.398) -> "Diseased".
issues.fix: Validate inputs before prediction (finite, within physical bounds, enough non-missing features); require a validated accuracy-above-baseline threshold for the cause task or do not serve it; never expose a disease label from satellite data alone.
issues.status_evidence: New scripts/ml/prediction_safety.py: one predict_with_safety function derives every check from the row. Re-ran the 7 safety cases (verify_safety.py): as shipped all abstain (True); with a deliberately permissive 0.30 threshold the validity gates still refuse missing observations, cloud (1 clear observation), inf / -inf / -999 / 1e12 and x1000 inputs in all three tasks (True). The stress-cause model also no longer answers at all, because only a model that passed the pre-registered validation bar may answer. 10 new unit tests.

issues.problem: The five deep-model artifacts are not self-contained. The .pt file holds weights only; the fitted imputer, scaler and sequence statistics are not saved, so predictions cannot be reproduced from the artifact.
issues.evidence: phase_models.json: all 15 deep entries have artifact_reload.loaded = false; they were verified only by re-fitting with the saved settings and seed (probability difference 0.0).
issues.fix: Save the preprocessing objects and architecture next to the weights and add a reload test.
issues.status_evidence: Deep models save .pt (weights, loadable with weights_only=True) + .json + .prep.joblib and reload with deep.load(); all 15 reload and reproduce probabilities to 0.0e+00. Unit test: save, reload, identical predictions.

issues.problem: The target labels do not support the requested outcome. Telangana labels are season-level survey cause categories with no severity (Mild / Moderate / Severe), no dates, one year (99% sown 2023), and cannot be independently verified. All 49 models score at chance on unseen districts.
issues.evidence: phase_data.json (labels, 99% single year); results.json selection.eligible = [] for all 3 tasks; shuffled-label AUC 0.491 vs real 0.499.
issues.fix: Collect dated, agronomist-confirmed severity observations; see PRODUCTION_READINESS.md.
issues.status_evidence: Cannot be fixed in code: needs dated, agronomist-confirmed severity labels.

issues.problem: The expected backend modules, "best model" folders and model_metadata.json do not exist. Backend integration was deliberately not done (no approved model; Telangana licence is evaluation-only).
issues.evidence: file listing in this report; no reference to any new model in backend/ or frontend/src (grep).
issues.fix: Create them only together with a model that clears validation and licence review.
issues.status_evidence: No model passed validation and the Telangana licence is evaluation-only, so nothing is integrated. The safety logic now exists as prediction_safety.py for when a model qualifies.

issues.problem: Originally recorded timings were taken while other processes were running (a large directory scan and unit tests), so they are inflated.
issues.evidence: Fresh benchmark vs original single-call p50: median ratio 0.86x, maximum 2.00x; deep-model final-fit time 1.6-2.7x higher than the clean re-run (phase_fit_time.json).
issues.fix: Use the verified numbers in this report; re-run the pipeline on an idle machine for the final record.
issues.status_evidence: Whole pipeline re-run with --force on an idle machine. Recorded single-call p50 now vs the fresh verification benchmark: median ratio 0.86, range 0.54 to 2.00 (before: median 1.57, up to 5.15).

issues.problem: Held-out district and season scores are slightly optimistic: the hyperparameters were tuned on main-train rows that include the held-out district's fields, and the refit reuses them.
issues.evidence: code path: tune() uses td.train; held-out loops call fit(..., params, s["train"]).
issues.fix: Nested tuning inside each held-out fold. Effect is small here because every model is near chance.
issues.status_evidence: Held-out folds now tune on their own training rows (nested): 294 nested searches, 0 fallbacks to the main settings. The budget is deliberately small (2 trials, 2-fold CV for classical; 1 trial for deep): the aim is no leakage, not a better search.

issues.problem: No genuinely independent test set exists. Test metrics were computed for every model and were visible when the report text was written and during this verification; selection never reads them (unit-tested), but the same 547 fields were reused.
issues.evidence: splits.json has one test split; no other labelled satellite dataset is available.
issues.fix: Evaluate once on new, dated field observations collected after the pass limit is agreed.
issues.status_evidence: No other labelled satellite dataset exists, so no genuinely independent test set can be made. The limitation remains.

issues.problem: The "ndvi_rule" baseline is a feature-based approximation of the app's two triggers, not a replay of shared/evidence.ts (which compares comparable pairs by tile and method).
issues.evidence: source inspection; its test AUC 0.524 vs the earlier node replay on 750 fields (0.454).
issues.fix: Replay the real rule through node for the baseline.
issues.status_evidence: The baseline now replays the app's real alert (shared/evidence.ts + advice.ts) through scripts/evaluate-telangana-alerts.mjs on all 3725 fields: it flags 80% of problem fields and 79% of healthy fields; its test balanced accuracy is 0.536. The pipeline runs the replay as a step.

issues.problem: Explanations are unstable and lean on observation-quality proxies. For Healthy vs Problem the permutation ranking agrees between two seeds at only 0.45 (rank correlation) and with TreeSHAP at 0.03; the top features across tasks include clear_fraction and area_ha.
issues.fix: Do not present these as evidence of crop condition; they describe a model at chance.
issues.status_evidence: explain.json now carries a reliability block per task (ranking stability and whether the model has validated skill); explanation_reliable = [False, False, False], each with a warning. The instability itself is a property of models at chance and cannot be fixed.

issues.status_evidence: PyTorch stays a CPU build; no GPU is used or claimed.

independence_limits: The same author built and verified this. Independence comes from separate code paths (raw CSV recounts, direct scikit-learn metric calls, artifact reloads), not from a different person, machine or dataset.
